g.text: PF-Q. Dates on which persistence was worse than W1 for both wind and MSLP: how many, and errors on them
Evidence E (panel directive). Selected validation example chosen to demonstrate baseline limitations as requested by the thesis panel; not representative of all historical
dates. Dates selected because persistence's wind and MSLP errors were both larger than W1's. W1 < persistence here by construction.
Qualifying station-date: |persistence error| > |W1 error| for wind AND for MSLP (strict). Share = qualifying / station-dates with complete wind and MSLP. W1 = saved neural-only next-day output
(website scorecard cohort, target dates 2021-11-16 to 2024-12-30); persistence = issue-day observation; climatology = station × month mean 2015-2020; truth = raw PAGASA observations. Spec:
